attchmntText: Indo Farm Equipment Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication Corrigendum to Un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indo Farm Equipment Limited submitted a corrigendum to the newspaper publication of its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The correction addresses an inadvertent typographical error in the Financial Express and Jansatta newspapers published on November 14, 2026. The error involved the Revenue from Operations Consolidated figure for the six months ended September 30, 2026. The figure was incorrectly printed as Rs. 2,28,483.76 lac. The correct figure is Rs. 22,483.76 lac. The company states that the financial results filed with the stock exchanges remain correct and unchanged. The error is confined only to the newspaper publication. All other contents of the original publication remain unchanged.

attchmntText: Indo Farm Equipment Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Indo Farm Equipment Limited submitted a clarification regarding an inadvertent typographical error in newspaper advertisements dated November 14, 2026. The company reported that the Consolidated Revenue from Operations for the six months ended September 30, 2026, was incorrectly published as Rs. 2,28,483.76 lac instead of Rs. 22,483.76 lac. The Board of Directors approved the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The company confirmed that the results filed with BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 13, 2026, are correct. The error is confined to the newspaper publication. Indo Farm Equipment Limited is taking necessary steps to publish corrigenda in The Financial Express and The Chandigarh Jansatta to rectify the error.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30,2026.
voiceSummary: Indo Farm Equipment Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of IPO proceeds. Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited issued the report. The net proceeds available for utilization were Rs. 168.06 crore. The company utilized Rs. 129.46 crore as of the quarter end. Unutilized proceeds stood at Rs. 38.60 crore, excluding interest. The remaining funds were invested in fixed deposits with ICICI Bank. The total amount invested in these instruments was Rs. 43.79 crore. The report confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. The company is a manufacturer of tractors and pick and carry cranes. The IPO was conducted between December 31, 2024, and January 02, 2025.

attchmntText: Indo Farm Equipment Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indo Farm Equipment Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone profit after tax was 462.12 lakhs for the quarter and 967.87 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated profit after tax was 539.99 lakhs for the quarter and 1,105.73 lakhs for the half year. Standalone revenue from operations was 10,896.10 lakhs for the quarter and 21,389.31 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated revenue from operations was 11,459.46 lakhs for the quarter and 22,483.76 lakhs for the half year. Standalone basic earnings per share was 0.96 for the quarter and 2.01 for the half year. Consolidated basic earnings per share was 1.12 for the quarter and 2.30 for the half year. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the limited review of these results.
